a.description: array_like Input array, a (subclass of) ndarray.

mask.description: sequence, optional Mask. Must be convertible to an array of booleans with the same shape as `data`. True indicates a masked (i.e. invalid) data.

copy.description: bool, optional Whether to use a copy of `a` (True) or to fix `a` in place (False). Default is True.

fill_value.description: scalar, optional Value used for fixing invalid data. Default is None, in which case the ``a.fill_value`` is used.
constraints: fill_value must be one of a.fill_value

output.description: ------- MaskedArray The input array with invalid entries fixed.
